headline: Telus Focuses on Core Telecom After Writing Down Health Business
summary: Telus reported a mixed third-quarter result, taking a write-down on its health business as it pivots toward cost cuts and AI investments for profitable growth.
why: Corporate restructuring and asset write-downs affect valuation models and highlight shifts in strategic focus for telecommunications providers.

impacts.why: Asset write-downs and strategic shifts directly impact earnings reports and investor evaluations.
